mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, we are seeing overcast skies with temperatures around 76 degrees at Reddan Soccer Park under a third quarter moon.

The City of Verona remains committed to infrastructure excellence with regular engineering reports provided to the City Council, and residents can also take advantage of a rebate program by installing rain barrels to help manage stormwater.
We have a busy day in store with the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market and Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at the Wisconsin Brewing Company happening today, plus Concerts in the Park tomorrow.
A notable call for service occurred on July 31st, when an officer stopped a vehicle for an equipment violation and arrested the driver for O W I and suspended registration.
It is a perfect day for a scoop of Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie at Culver's, and since they are open until 10 PM, you have plenty of time to head over.
